dataList.content:
Two things changed the moment the Wuthering Heights manor appeared over the horizon.
在可以从远处看见呼啸山庄宅邸的同时，有两个显而易见的变化同时浮现。
dataList.place:
Wuthering Heights Approach
前往呼啸山庄的道路

dataList.content:
Mirror… I need a mirror. Anyone got a mirror? Come on, anyone?
镜子……有带着镜子的家伙吗？喂，什么都行，快给我。

What has gotten into you, Heathcliff… T-this mirror isn't—
为什么……为什么要这样。希斯克利夫……这镜子……

One was Heathcliff, who was suddenly overcome with intense anxiety…
变化之一是希斯克利夫身上剧增的紧张与不安……

And the other was the weather that grew dark and tempestuous all of a sudden.
而另一个是剧变的恶劣天气。

<… What a terrifying noise.>
<……好吓人的声音啊。>
dataList.place:
Aboard Mephistopheles
梅菲斯托费勒斯 内部

dataList.content:
Was the weather here always this awful?
这里是天气原本就如此恶劣的地方吗？

It was always this… windy, yeah. Almost like a constant tempest.
风……总是如此猛烈地呼啸。如同风暴一般。

But this thunder and lightning...?
但这闪电和……雷鸣是……

Well, the weather at Wuthering Heights was always this awful, thunder or not.
算了，不管怎么说，呼啸山庄的天气一直都很奇怪。

That really is one massive manor if it looks that big from this far away.
哪怕从远处看去……宅邸也大得惊人。

Charon can’t see well. Not sure if this is the right place. But we're here.
卡戎的眼睛朦朦胧胧。朦朦胧胧地到达了。

Lightning goes boom. Eyes go ow.
闪电霹嚓霹嚓。眼睛疼。

This manor looked as though it came straight out of a dark, gothic tale full of mysteries. I was half expecting to hear a haunting cry echoing from its windows.
这座宅邸给人一种大概会在古老而充满悲泣和谜团的故事中出场的感觉。

<So are we just waiting for Vergilius to go ‘off the bus’ again?>
<维吉里乌斯这次也会说让我们在这里下车吗？>

When hasn’t that been the case, manager bud...?
还没有一次不是那样吧……

I mean, it's not like we're digging into a Lobotomy Corp. Branch or entering one of the Wings, right? It's just a manor, so I don't see what's stopping him from coming with us.
而且迄今为止都是支部或是公司呢。而这次只是普通的宅邸……

Now, off the bus.
来，下车吧。

Charon and I—
我和卡戎……

—will wait outside until we're done with our mission?
……这次也会在外面等着？

None of the Sinners were hiding their dissatisfaction with Vergilius. Some of them were even standing with their arms crossed.
罪人们抱着胳膊，对维吉里乌斯露出了不满的表情。

By the looks on your faces… clearly, you all collectively have something to say.
看你们的表情，大概也有一起想说的话吧。

I… of course not. Ahem. I... I would hardly ever dare to challenge thee.
吾……吾没有。怎敢……唔嗯。总、总之吾什么都没想。

Well, maybe not every Sinner.
……好吧，好像也不是所有罪人都这样。

We’ve gone through a lot of things, survived various trials and tribulations. Tribulations that could’ve been easily handled had Vergilius been there with us.
在我们经历过的种种磨难之中，倘若维吉里乌斯在场便能轻松渡过的瞬间不在少数，这也是事实。

So...
因此……

Vergilius.
维吉里乌斯。

Looks like Ishmael decided to step up as our representative.
似乎这次以实玛利决心鼓起勇气代表我们发言。

You introduced yourself to us as our ‘guide’, didn’t you?
你最开始是对我们自称为“向导”的吧？

So what kind of 'guide' just tosses everyone at the start of the journey and goes off on their own with the bus driver? Where are you guys even going?
但遑论引路了，每次作战都只是把我们扔在起点。你和卡戎小姐到底干什么去了？

I want to make it clear that I’m not being a hardass for no good reason.
我并非是在无谓地发脾气。我想要先明确这一点。

I’m asking you, because I want to trust you.
我是因为想要信任你才问你的。

After all, we’re technically all in the same boat. We're coworkers. I’d say the least you could do is to tell us where we’re headed.
如果我们还是同舟共济的同事，至少应该告诉我们工作的目的地吧。

Vergilius held his silence for a moment. His brows were not as furrowed as they usually are… which was the only indicator to me that he wasn’t as offended to hear this as I thought he’d be.
维吉里乌斯暂时保持了沉默。他的眉间没有像以前那样紧锁着，证明他并不认为自己被这些话所冒犯。

… Just like you Sinners who joined this company via your individual contracts…
……就像你们通过特定的合同进入公司一样……

I also signed a contract. With specific clauses and conditions I must abide by.
我也是通过签署一份包含某些条件的合同加入的。

Huh? The company made thee, a color most illustrious, sign a contract as well?
嗯？特色老爷也签了合同吗？

Of course I did. Why would I be babysitting you children on this bus otherwise? I'm not one to work for free.
当然。你觉得我会不计较得失就到这巴士上当你们这群小毛孩的保姆吗？

I don’t want to bother detailing each and every clause of my contract to you, nor should I…
我不想，也不能告诉你们详细的合同内容……

... But Ishmael, I quite liked that you used the word 'trust' in your speech. So I believe that you deserve at least a brief explanation.
……但以实玛利，我很中意你发言中的“信任”一词。所以我在此简短地解释一下。

I am not supposed to retrieve the Golden Boughs myself, nor am I allowed to provide you with any direct support. The contract stipulates that I must leave everything to the manager and the Sinners.
我不能自行回收金枝，也不能向你们提供任何直接的支援。合同规定了我必须将一切交给经理和罪人们处理。

Why… the hell would you sign a contract like that…?
为什么……要签那种合同……

As always, it's meaningless to ask me 'why'.
无论何时，问我“为什么”都没有意义。

Contracts are rarely ever fully understood by those that are not a part of it.
毕竟合同是以让当事人以外无法完全理解的形式签订的。

But...
但是……

What I can tell you is that… when I ask you Sinners to leave this bus for a mission...
在到达目的地之后，我让你们下车的时候。

... I suppose, in a way, I... say it with a lighter heart than I used to.
我可以说自己在某种程度上放下心来了。

I am no longer concerned that, in my desire to fulfill the conditions for every clause in my contract, the manager might be irreversibly... hurt. I would be left with nothing if such a thing were to happen.
在我竭力遵守合同的每个条款的同时，我不用那么担心经理会受到不可逆的损伤，因而让我再失去一切了。

<Did he just admit to trusting us more than he used to…?>
<他刚刚是承认了自己比之前更信任我们了吗……？>

Don't make him repeat something like that, Dante~
但丁~这种事最好不要特意问回去啦。

Especially when someone went through the trouble of expressing their true, hidden feelings.
特别是当某人经过内心挣扎，终于表现出他真实的情感的时候。

Besides...
此外……

W-wait...
等、等一下……

I am NOT going in there like this.
我绝不会就这样下车。

Nope, can’t do this. Oi, turn the bus around!
不行，回去吧。掉个头不就行了吗。

Mephi doesn’t do U-turns.
梅菲，不会掉头。

Bollocks… I ain’t going back to the manor in these wrinkly rags!
咕……我怎么能以这种丑态回到宅邸！

Oh yeah, right… every single one of our elaborate plans to dress him up in fancy clothes fell through.
回想起来，为打扮希斯克利夫进行的每一项尝试全都泡汤了……

<Hey, you don’t look *that* bad...>
<算了，也不是完全看不下去……>

If I go back in these rags, those bastards will—
要是我穿着这几块破布回去，那些混蛋会……

... Those 'bastards'? Who are they?
……那些混蛋是谁？

Bastards that'd always eye me up and down, trying to find a speck of dust, a single flaw, something to latch onto just to humiliate me…
……从很久以前开始，一见面就翻着白眼想着要羞辱我的家伙……

Then gouge out their eyes.
那就把他们的眼珠子挖出来。

Oho, that would be quite the clever solution.
噢，真是才华横溢的方案。

What are you even…
什么……

Looks like Heathcliff is the only one who’s taking this seriously.
……看来，认真考虑这件事的好像只有希斯克利夫。

Fuhu...
呼呼……

Huhu...
呼呼……

The hell is wrong with the pair of you? Quit gigglin’ like that!
怎么回事？你们两个为什么笑得那么阴险？

Good thing we came prepared exactly for this occasion~!
就知道会变成这样~所以我们早有准备了~

I just couldn’t imagine Heath managing to pull off this makeover on his own.
无论怎么想……我们的希斯都很难自己打扮得漂漂亮亮的吧。

Rodya and I did some shopping in the Backstreets before we entered the Nest.
很久之前，我和罗佳一起在进巢之前去后巷买了些东西。

We were waiting to reveal these just in case there was anything more impressive in the Nest, but thanks to the disappointing lack of anything even remotely interesting… we’ll just make do with what we picked up earlier.
本来想着巢里应该有比后巷更好的东西所以一直没说，但到处都找不到好店。虽然很遗憾但就凑合着用之前买的东西吧。

Wait a bloody second. When the two of you went off on your own… No. All you brought back was a whole basket of cookies, wasn't it?
什么，该不会是之前说要两个人去哪里的时候……不对，那次不是只买了一大筐子零食回来吗……

Those cookies were decoy cookies, Heath! Though some of ‘em did end up as a part of my daily sustenance, of course… heh.
那些零食是烟雾弹，希斯。当然，其中的一部分变成了我的日常干粮，呵呵。

While I couldn’t find the particular brands I used back home… these should be more than enough for a proper fashion makeover.
虽然没找到我在家里使用过的品牌……但这应该能在某种程度上应付场面了。

Hm.
哼。

Verg, c’mon. Can't we keep things nice and happy for once, hmm? Let him wear something else other than his uniform. Just for today.
维吉，为了让良好的氛围持续下去这次就睁一只眼闭一只眼吧，嗯？就不要强制他穿制服了。

Like, no one wants to meet their old flame while wearing their work clothes, right?
没人想穿着公司制服去见久别重逢的恋人吧？对吧？

W-well, I doubt the guide’ll ever let anything like that sli—
但、但那位向导会这样轻易地允——

Fine.
行吧。

What...!
什……！

I would prefer it if we didn’t have to encourage another rogue incident with the Backdoor.
毕竟我想要避免又有人未经许可，结伴进出后门的情况。

Seriously?! Guide…!!!
真的吗？！向导！！！

Heathcliff trembled like he was about to give Vergilius a big hug.
希斯克利夫看上去就像是要马上给维吉里乌斯一个紧紧的拥抱一样。

Now, Heathcliff, close your eyes...
好了希斯克利夫先生，闭上眼睛……

Relax… and let us take care of everything. Pretend you’re at the proverbial peach blossom spring.
想象自己正身处世外桃源，把身心都交给我们吧。

Wait, don’t touch my hair like—
等下，别那样碰我的头发……

Woah...
噢……

Oi, you ain’t half bad...
哇，手艺真不错啊。

dataList.title:
Sinner #6
6号罪人
dataList.content:
Shh~ Heathcliff’s getting a makeover!
嘘~希斯克利夫先生正在打扮中！

Some time later...
一段时间后……

Ahem...
咳……

Um… I think you might’ve overdone it with the hair.
那个，头发……是不是抹太多油了？

Don’t touch it! Do you even have any idea how hard Hong Lu worked on that?
不许碰，鸿璐特别努力才弄好的，那样摸的话就~

... Where'd his bat go?
……你拿着的球棒去哪儿了？

It’s a reunion of the century! We can’t possibly let him say hello to his old flame with a big brutish club in his hand~
时隔多年的再会，怎么能拿着球棒去见面呢~！

Sir Heathcliff appeareth... a tad more merciful than usual. Mayhaps he shall accept my request should I implore him to purchase me a pint of ice-crrream...
希斯克利夫先生……吾视之甚是亲切。若要作比的话……就是倘若请汝帮忙去买冰激凌，汝就会马上前往的感觉……

And he no longer looks like he's on the verge of punching me when I make the smallest noises!
还有，感觉就算我多嘴他也不会打我了！

Lad, please... please don't bring up anything even remotely like that in front of Catherine…
喂，求你们千万别在凯瑟琳面前说那种话……

Well, I'll be. Clothes really do make the man. Do let me know how this reunion goes; I’ll be looking forward to hearing that tale.
呵，真是人靠衣装啊。我会期待着你再会的感想的。

Ahm… s-sure.
咳哼……好、好的。

<So, Heathcliff?>
<不过，希斯克利夫。>

I’ve been meaning to ask this question for a while. I wanted to know the answer… but I couldn’t bring myself to ask him.
我一直有一个如鲠在喉，但怎么也问不出来的问题。

<Why’d you leave Wuthering Heights? It's where the love of your life lives, isn't it?>
<你为什么会离开呼啸山庄？那里明明有你心爱的人。>

Heathcliff, who’d been busily moving about and preparing to leave the bus, suddenly comes to a halt.
希斯克利夫匆忙的身影瞬间僵住了。

... I didn’t mind it. The thrashings, the starvings, the abuse, them treatin' me like a servant, like I'm something beneath them...
……我无论怎样都没关系。被打也好，挨饿也好，忍受粗暴对待的同时被肆意使唤也好。

I didn’t mind being treated like I’m nothing more than an afterthought, like I'm some impure trash to be discarded.
哪怕被当作陪衬、渣滓对待，我也能忍受。

But when I heard what… Catherine said...
但是……从凯瑟琳口中……说出那句话的瞬间……

… I realized that I no longer had any reason to remain in that manor.
……我留在那座宅邸的理由，全都消失了。

Heathcliff did not elaborate further.
希斯克利夫嘟囔着，没再说什么。

Perhaps it wasn't that he didn't, but that he couldn't bring himself to...
或者说他是不能再说什么了吗……

I didn't dare ask him what he was about to say, so I simply nodded in response.
我无法问出他欲言又止的话是什么，只能点头回应。

<I see… >
<原来如此……>

Ooh, looks like Charon’s got something to say about your new fit!
哦，看来卡戎对希斯的新形象有话要说？

Mhm, Charon has something to say. Something big.
嗯，没错。是重大发表。

Great, awesome! Now, Charon! What do ya think~?
好好好！那么！请发表您的感想~

Looks oily and greasy. Charon doesn't like greasy.
卡戎讨厌黄油。因为又稠又黏。

Oh… This… isn’t how I thought it’d go… ha ha…
啊哈哈……不该是这样的啊……

Charon’s words must’ve hit him hard.
希斯克利夫好像被那句话伤得不轻。

It took quite a bit of convincing for Heathcliff, who was severely discouraged by Charon’s remark, to exit the bus.
……而把希斯克利夫哄出来，又费了不少时间。
